instruction: Use ug-document extract on the file Invoices/Ana Ruiz - Nov 2.pdf to get the cleaning invoice details: invoice date, service date and times (start and end), hourly rate, billed hours and total amount. Return the extracted fields.
Use ug-surveillance cameras to list the cameras and identify the camera named Front Door (return its camera-id). Note the user confirmed the cameras recognise faces and may be used to check hours.

Use ug-surveillance event-timeline with start-time 2026-11-02 00:00, end-time 2026-11-02 23:59, timezone America/New_York, camera-id or location for the Front Door camera (name Front Door, location Entrance), topic Human, identity-type all, limit 100. Return every event with its timestamp, camera and identity. The user confirmed the cameras recognise faces and may be used to check hours, so this is authorised.
